question: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, join to the food dimension and classify each line as Veg, Non-Veg, or Unknown (null or unmatched food ID). Report for each group: (1) item-line count, (2) total ordered units, (3) share of total ordered units computed as group ordered units divided by the sum of ordered units across all three groups times 100. State the total ordered units used as the denominator.

action.query:
WITH food_map AS (
  SELECT FOOD_ID,
         CASE
           WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(FOOD_NAME))) = 1 AND MAX(UPPER(TRIM(FOOD_NAME))) IS NOT NULL THEN
             CASE
               WHEN COUNT_IF(UPPER(TRIM(FOOD_NAME)) = 'VEG') > 0 THEN 'Veg'
               WHEN COUNT_IF(UPPER(TRIM(FOOD_NAME)) = 'NON-VEG') > 0 THEN 'Non-Veg'
               ELSE 'Unknown'
             END
           ELSE 'Unknown'
         END AS food_group
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__FOOD
  GROUP BY FOOD_ID
), line_groups AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN fm.FOOD_ID IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' ELSE fm.food_group END AS food_group,
         oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID,
         COALESCE(oi.QUANTITY, 0) AS ordered_units
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER_ITEM oi
  JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  LEFT JOIN food_map fm ON oi.F_ID = fm.FOOD_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), totals AS (
  SELECT food_group, COUNT(*) AS item_line_count, SUM(ordered_units) AS ordered_units
  FROM line_groups
  GROUP BY food_group
)
SELECT food_group, item_line_count, ordered_units,
       ordered_units * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ordered_units) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total_ordered_units_pct,
       SUM(ordered_units) OVER () AS denominator_total_ordered_units
FROM totals
ORDER BY CASE food_group WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
action.metrics: 2025 item-line count, ordered units, share of total ordered units (%) and denominator, classified by food group
action.group_by: Food group: Veg, Non-Veg, Unknown (null or unmatched food ID; ambiguous or other food labels treated as Unknown)

action.query:
WITH food_map AS (
  SELECT FOOD_ID,
         CASE
           WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG))) = 1
                AND MAX(UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG))) = 'VEG' THEN 'Veg'
           WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG))) = 1
                AND MAX(UPPER(TRIM(VEG_OR_NON_VEG))) = 'NON-VEG' THEN 'Non-Veg'
           ELSE 'Unknown'
         END AS food_group
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__FOOD
  GROUP BY FOOD_ID
), classified_lines AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN oi.F_ID IS NULL OR fm.FOOD_ID IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
           ELSE fm.food_group
         END AS food_group,
         oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID,
         COALESCE(oi.QUANTITY, 0) AS ordered_units
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER_ITEM oi
  JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  LEFT JOIN food_map fm ON oi.F_ID = fm.FOOD_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), groups AS (
  SELECT column1 AS food_group FROM VALUES ('Veg'), ('Non-Veg'), ('Unknown')
), totals AS (
  SELECT food_group, COUNT(*) AS item_line_count, SUM(ordered_units) AS ordered_units
  FROM classified_lines
  GROUP BY food_group
), complete_totals AS (
  SELECT g.food_group,
         COALESCE(t.item_line_count, 0) AS item_line_count,
         COALESCE(t.ordered_units, 0) AS ordered_units
  FROM groups g LEFT JOIN totals t USING (food_group)
)
SELECT food_group, item_line_count, ordered_units,
       ordered_units * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ordered_units) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total_ordered_units_pct,
       SUM(ordered_units) OVER () AS denominator_total_ordered_units
FROM complete_totals
ORDER BY CASE food_group WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
action.metrics: 2025 item-line count, ordered units, share of total ordered units (%) and denominator, classified using VEG_OR_NON_VEG
action.group_by: Food group: Veg, Non-Veg, Unknown (null or unmatched food ID; nonstandard or ambiguous dimension classification treated as Unknown)
Food group for item lines on orders dated 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31
action.answer: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, the total ordered units used as the denominator is 12,230,877 units. Veg: 7,277,939 item lines; 8,877,759 ordered units; 72.584811% of total units. Non-Veg: 2,749,222 item lines; 3,353,105 ordered units; 27.415082%. Unknown (null or unmatched food ID): 12 item lines; 13 ordered units; 0.000106%. Shares are group ordered units divided by 12,230,877, multiplied by 100; minor difference from 100% is due to rounding.
